purpose: Prove enforcement semantics for one exact dry-run executor plan using synthetic in-memory effects before any operating-system or remote-hardware executor is trusted.

attack_classes.required_control: Validate canonical plan digest plus supported compiler ID/version/policy digest before any admission.
Reject any plan whose fixed repository-code or repository-shell hazard markers differ from the compiler templates.
Match fixed executable IDs exactly and reject environment names outside the compiled allowlist, including PATH.
Require literal argv equality to the compiled template and perform no shell interpretation.
Require canonical relative paths rooted at work/session; reject absolute, backslash, dot-segment, duplicate-separator and out-of-root paths.
Fail closed whenever the synthetic path-resolution evidence reports a symlink; future real executors require OS-enforced no-follow semantics.
Require exact compiled origin/method, no redirect target, and no credentialed/dynamic origin discovery.
Bind effect-time synthetic addresses to the exact preflight snapshot and reject any address-set change.
Public-read snapshots accept only public address classes; owner-LAN snapshots accept only local/private address classes.
Check process, per-process runtime, total runtime, output, memory, step and request ceilings before virtual admission.
Require the exact issued head used by the plan and consume the one-time in-memory lifecycle immediately before the first admitted virtual effect.
Interruption is terminal in the lifecycle ledger and the sandbox cannot complete after a denial/interruption.
Require unique request IDs and strict next-step sequence matching.
Sign canonical receipts with Ed25519 and verify the trusted executor public-key fingerprint plus exact plan binding.
Receipts hard-code real effects, task success, production authority and capability promotion to false.

promotion_blockers: No real executor process launcher exists.
No operating-system sandbox profile is implemented or verified.
No live DNS resolution/pinning implementation exists.
No durable atomic lifecycle store is integrated with an executor.
No real package/build/test execution is permitted by this laboratory.
No remote hardware transport, credential broker or production node-enrollment path exists.
